peer_results.rationale: The supplied candidates for Bank of America disclose commercial real estate loan composition (bac_2024_7_D053) or general capital and RWA changes driven by client activity (bac_2024_7_D186). Neither candidate specifically addresses the breakdown of off-balance-sheet RWA components or the specific Basel III Standardized vs. Advanced Credit risk RWA distinctions central to the JPMorgan disclosure.

comparisons.peer_summary: Citigroup's CET1 Capital ratio increased to 13.6% as of December 31, 2024, from 13.4% in 2023, driven by net income and a decrease in risk-weighted assets, partially offset by dividends, share repurchases, and AOCI movements.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citigroup disclose their CET1 capital ratios derived under the Basel III Standardized Approach as of December 31, 2024. JPMorgan provides specific RWA rollforward data for off-balance-sheet components within this framework, showing Standardized Credit risk RWA of $208.0 billion. Citigroup explicitly states its binding CET1 Capital ratio was 13.6% as of December 31, 2024, based on the Basel III Standardized Approach, driven by net income and a decrease in RWA.

sentences.text: (c)As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Basel III Standardized Credit risk RWA included wholesale and retail off balance-sheet RWA of $208.0 billion and $208.5 billion, respectively; and the Basel III Advanced Credit risk RWA included wholesale and retail off balance-sheet RWA of $192.1 billion and $188.5 billion, respectively.
Citigroup's CET1 Capital ratio was 13.6% as of December 31, 2024, compared to 13.4% as of December 31, 2023, based on the Basel III Standardized Approach for determining risk weighted assets (RWA).

peer_results.rationale: The supplied candidates for Goldman Sachs define leverage exposure for TLAC purposes (gs_2024_7_D172) or describe general liquidity and asset-liability management processes (gs_2024_7_D116). These do not provide comparable specific data on off-balance-sheet RWA components under Basel III Standardized or Advanced approaches.

The supplied candidates for Morgan Stanley discuss drivers of Operational risk RWA increase (ms_2024_7_D181) and Market risk RWA increase (ms_2024_7_D180). These are distinct risk categories from the Credit risk off-balance-sheet RWA components disclosed by JPMorgan.
